notes.title: "Mosaique Neko Waifus 3" just released!
notes.content:
Ahh "Mosaique Neko Waifus". The forbidden pleasure...
Well not any longer!

The new one is out NOW! So grab a copy if this is your thing ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385730/Mosaique_Neko_Waifus_3/
What's new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/130cb1dcb42cd74cc8b660d74fdb5a3b7e5cb2b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/e9f505e8dc44510f06e9d81f6e097911d522ef28.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/bad349e0499b01c71eb811f50e6f59a39ca754ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/353798730706e2b2013309f6ee72891717ed4ade.jpg[/img]

• 2 new girls: Coco and Luli.
• 2 new old girls: Sayouri and Niko
• 14 classic abilities that have not been changed much
• 4 new abilities: Love Axe, Laser Burst, Mirroring Edge, and Lazy Bomb. You will love the Lazy Bomb if you are a strategic player
• Ability stash! There is only a limited amount of ability slots so you need to manage which ones you want to be equipped
• If you want new ability slots you need to farm "Bubble Wraps" from talking to girls
• 16 SFW Puzzles
• 90 Items
• 100 Achievements

( I cannot say whether there is a FREE R18 Expansion or not! But you never know, life might surprise you )

notes.title: BIG Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060471/95aec1690d180c810148807f1a5e5174d23f791a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060471/afa0b88b63d3534bfd3f1dba226026a39ee235d1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060471/3f7d6c691f3d1874f7c5c7f527051ba619380709.png[/img]

A lot of stuff has been added to the game. Which makes it a bit longer and a bit more fun.

• 3 New girls (well, that's not right, the final puzzle is made out of 2 girls..)
• 8 New Puzzles
• Girls TALK to you and comment on your progress
• Japanese + Korean localization
• Fix of camera dragging bug - which happened on low FPS
• A lot of new achievements, actually 41 new ones which makes a total of 51

CHEERS!
